tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search White Automotive & Media Services products by free text, for example "HMI module", "digital cluster Silverado" or "CarPlay retrofit". Returns a summary for each match: name, SKU, price, availability, categories, a short description and the product URL. Call get_product for full detail on a sp

tools.name: lookup_catalog
tools.description: List products within a product category or tag. Category slugs describe GM platforms and applications; tag slugs describe characteristics such as "global-a" or "vin-programmed". Use search_catalog first to discover which categories and tags exist. Returns the same summary shape as search_catalog; ca

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Retrieve one product by its SKU or its URL slug. Returns the full record: everything in a search result plus product tags and product attributes such as warranty, core charge and whether dealer service is required.
